majorMovements: Regaining man from a lost dominion
legacyContent.summary: A Hebrews 2:5–18 sermon emphasizing the humanity of Christ and His superiority through what He accomplished as a man: regaining man's lost dominion, bringing sons to the Father, conquering death's power, and serving as the sympathetic high priest.
closingResponse: Believe that Jesus is the Messiah

brl.idNote: SER-HEB-005 is retained as an existing legacy series-planning label; it is not treated here as a newly assigned permanent BRL sermon ID.

provenance.notes: Metadata records the legacy source without rewriting or modernizing the sermon.
